data_exposure: Development target answers previously scored for V2; exploratory reuse, not fresh validation.
baseline: Development history order count, descending; product ID breaks ties. Exclude all personal history before top 3.

challenger.binary_co_buyer_cosine: shared shoppers / sqrt(shoppers buying source * shoppers buying candidate)
challenger.seed_rank_and_weight: Existing five-order-half-life recency, descending; last purchase descending; product ID ascending.
challenger.score: Sum(seed recency * cosine); round to 12 decimals; product ID breaks ties.
challenger.fallback: Unfamiliar popularity fills remaining places after related candidates.

metrics.precision: Matches / 3 for every customer, including short lists
metrics.conditional_novel_recall: Matches / novel target products, averaged only over customers with at least one novel target product; report denominator
metrics.novel: Absent from complete recorded pre-target personal history

gate.note: Agent-selected exploratory project criterion, not a business standard. Passing only warrants review; no automatic audit or UI change.

audit: Not read or scored; any audit needs a separate fixed protocol.
limits: Per-customer order cutoffs, no shared calendar. Shared histories have cross-customer timing ambiguity. Not causal discovery or satisfaction evidence.
